title: OT Connector Point Library
description: A point library (contract §3.4): the data point list of one device type, in its own TOML file, carrying no connection information. Device instances reference it by name or path through `points_from` and supply only their own address. Point entries use the same fields as `device.point` in config.schema.json; only `id` is required, because a library may also carry a patch of a point another library in the same chain supplies.

protocol.description: The protocol module these points address. MUST equal the referencing connector's `[connector] protocol`: a point's `address` is protocol-specific, so a library is only ever valid for one protocol.

type.description: The device type this point list describes (§3.1). Every device that references the library inherits it unless it declares its own, and it qualifies their parameter set names (§5.2). Declared rather than derived from the file name, because it becomes a tenant-wide identifier in the cloud.

description.description: Informational: a human-readable account of what this list describes.

version.description: Informational: the version of the device type or of the list itself. Not interpreted; a library is identified by its file name.

point.description: The points, in order. A repeated `id` within one library is an error, not an override — there is no order in which to apply it (§3.4).

point.name: Boiler temp
point.description: Outlet temperature after the heat exchanger
